scope.summary: Activate the first real Tailor native surface integration seam against the merged WP-KERNEL-012 shell contract, replacing or graduating the design-only surface_extension_seam without assuming unused scaffold code is live.
acceptance_criteria: The seam is gated on merged-main WP-KERNEL-012 schema/receipt compatibility and registers Tailor panes, commands, state, navigation, jobs/problems/history, Argus, and UserManual anchors through canonical APIs.
Missing/incompatible shell capabilities return typed blockers; no WebView/Tauri fallback, hidden feature fork, or unused design-only registration can claim success.
Headless startup, multiple parallel sessions, layout restore, crash/restart, backend unavailable, and no-focus-steal behavior are proven.

The seam registers the 13.34 [TAI-UX-001] surface families and their TailorSurfaceDescriptorV1 navigation, AccessKit, Argus, backend-action, receipt, state, diagnostics, and UserManual bindings; semantic-tree inspection and direct native captures prove empty, loading, populated, conflict, failure, recovery, and success states.
scope.risk_if_missed: Tailor could be planned against a design-only seam and reach implementation with no real native host integration.

surfaces: Tailor native module and pane registration
Tailor project and Cloth workspace surface family
Tailor render, DCC, diagnostics, capabilities, and help surface family

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Create or recover a project > Open, restore, and recover the native Tailor workspace

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Pure computation or schema-only behavior has no independent lifecycle event; its owning run records inputs, outputs, diagnostics, and receipts.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.

Native surface registration and compatibility checks are bounded startup/integration operations and do not own a long-running process; jobs opened through the seam retain their own Palmistry registrations and identities.

risks: Tailor could be planned against a design-only seam and reach implementation with no real native host integration.
GUI, backend, agent, replay, and manual projections may drift if they do not consume the same typed authority.
minimum_controls: One typed owner and exact stable ids are required.
Negative, concurrent, cancellation, recovery, and no-context proofs are required where applicable.
No validator PASS/FAIL is inferred from this pre-activation contract.
